title: Government documents describe metallic, reflective, flat-bottomed objects

tellings.quote: These documents include the 1947 Twining memo, the 1948 Project Sign analysis, and the CIA's analysis of the 1952 DC UFO flyover, along with Blue Book lead Captain Edward J. Ruppelt's analysis and more.

plain: Between 1947 and 1952, US government documents described the objects people were seeing in the sky as metallic, reflective and flat on the bottom, Michels says in his own framing. He lists a 1947 memo known as the Twining memo, a 1948 analysis from Project Sign, an early Air Force study of the sightings, the CIA's analysis of UFOs flying over Washington, DC in 1952, and the analysis of Captain Edward J. Ruppelt, who led Blue Book, the US Air Force's UFO study of the 1950s and 60s. He points to them to show that officials themselves saw the objects as solid, built things.
